style: Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. ONE children's science picture book illustration, landscape aspect 1216:832. Warm watercolor and colored pencils on fine cream paper, friendly refined rounded shapes, clear educational detail and believable construction, age 4-8. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or panel borders. Leave important objects comfortably inside margins. No baked-in arrows; all labels and arrows are added separately by the website.
scenes: Cover: silver bell-shaped astronaut return capsule with broad black heat-shield base, narrow rounded top, round window, gently descending under huge orange-and-white parachute toward distant green meadow, blue sky. Capsule lower-center, chute upper half, taut suspension lines connect top, realistic modest scale. No text or flames.

Whole bell capsule three-quarter technical overview on quiet pale blue background. Rounded top parachute bay cap, silver curved pressure body, single round blue window on front face, broad thick black heat shield along bottom clearly visible. Complete silhouette, no cutaway, no parachute deployed. Four distinct touch targets.

MACRO cutaway wedge of capsule protective wall, curved layers separated just enough to see stack: outer charred black heat-resistant surface on left, brown sacrificial ablative material middle, silver inner pressure hull right leading to cool pale interior. One continuous cross-section not three unrelated capsules, tactile materials clearly distinct. No fire inside.

Close side cutaway of capsule during atmospheric descent, broad BLACK BASE oriented down-left into oncoming air. Thin warm orange plasma layer hugs outside base only, brown sacrificial material charred exterior; protected silver cabin behind shield upper-right remains cool, two blue-suited astronauts safely strapped inside. No flames in cabin, no parachute during reentry.

Interior cutaway inside silver bell capsule: exactly THREE contoured padded blue seats reclined side by side in triangular compact layout, three adult astronauts in white-and-blue suits secured with harnesses. Round window upper-left, compact readable unlettered control panel upper-right. Clear safe human anatomy, interior coherent pressure shell, no loose tools.

Detailed top compartment cutaway, silver dome cover hinged up at upper-left, circular parachute bay beneath at center. Tightly folded orange-and-white main canopy packed inside with coiled suspension lines, separate much smaller folded pilot chute in adjacent compact pocket. Mechanically clear packed parachute assembly; NOT a full inflated canopy emerging in space, no arrows.

Ground-level side view final instant before touchdown. Same silver bell capsule suspended less than one capsule-height above grassy plain, broad black base horizontal; two tiny downward-firing braking thrusters near lower rim make short symmetrical pale orange jets and small dust puffs beneath. Orange-white parachute high above partly outside frame connected by taut lines. No huge rocket plume, no people nearby.

Over-shoulder intimate cabin closeup: adult white-and-blue-suited astronaut at LEFT looks through large round window center-right. Through glass, curved blue-green Earth with white cloud bands fills view against black space. Thick circular window rim and cool silver inner wall clear. Human proportions correct, no exterior suited floating person.

Orbital docking scene. Same silver bell crew capsule attached nose-first to short docking adapter at LEFT, adapter meets a circular docking port on silver station module at RIGHT, no gap at contact point. Station has blue rectangular solar wings, Earth curve far below. Capsule black base faces away from station, no parachute, no reentry flame, no astronauts outdoors. Connection readable near center.

Wide atmospheric reentry trajectory scene: silver bell capsule moving BASE-FIRST down-left toward curved blue atmospheric rim. Its dark broad heat-shield face leads at lower-left, thin bright orange plasma sheath wraps leading edge and trails up-right behind capsule. Cool space and curved Earth. NO parachute, no rocket flame nozzle, no exposed astronauts.

Wide peaceful descent after reentry: huge fully inflated ORANGE AND WHITE striped parachute upper half, many taut thin lines converge onto top of small silver bell capsule beneath at center. Capsule black base faces DOWN. Blue sky soft clouds, green meadow bottom fifth. Far from trees and buildings. No flame or smoke.

Safe completed touchdown on broad green meadow. Silver bell capsule upright, charred black base rests firmly on ground, side hatch open with small step; smiling astronaut being helped by rescue worker, additional rescue team at a respectful safe distance. Collapsed orange-white parachute lies flat on grass behind, connected slack cords. Daylight, no fire or active engines.

Unlabeled recap on cream-blue background: medium silver bell return capsule center. Seven? EXACTLY SIX separated surrounding object studies: broad black heat-shield disc top-left, orange-white parachute upper-center, blue padded seat lower-left, small braking thruster lower-center, round window upper-right, docking ring lower-right. All detached studies visually distinct from central whole capsule, no numbering or orbit paths, no arrows.
